assignment: Coordinate minor selection: dimension-free determinant-weighted averaging/selection from three large absolute eigenvalues.

new_results.name: QFORM-TWO-SIDED-PLUCKER-CROSSBLOCK-v1
new_results.scope: arbitrary symmetric A with an original-coordinate rank-three cross block B=L Sigma R^T whose left and right singular frames admit basis laws with marginals <=1/2
new_results.statement: ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3e |det Sigma|^(-1/3) exp((D_L+D_R)/6), with a continuous density vanishing at infinity; for disjoint-basis masses delta_L,delta_R this becomes 3e [P_3(B) delta_L delta_R]^(-1/6). Arbitrary self blocks, outside couplings, signs and extra eigenvalues are retained.

new_results.name: QFORM-LOCALIZED-ISOTROPIC-BANK-DICHOTOMY-v1
new_results.statement: If Pluecker disjointness delta>=1/8, partner gives ||p||<=6e. If delta<1/8, some row has leverage >1/6; either normalized Rayleigh >=1/2 and account03/B10 gives ||p||<283, or off-diagonal row energy >1/8 and Q=dX_i^2+cX_iY+R with X_i independent of cap-one Y and |c|>1/2, where Y retains exact original product-linear provenance.
